items.title: Easy Apple Pie Recipe
items.description: This is the apple pie I make when the holiday table needs a comforting classic. A mix of your favorite apple varieties, two pie crusts, and a gently spiced filling that doesn’t need cooking before the pie is assembled make this recipe so easy to put together. The slices go into the shell raw and turn tender in the oven! I have tested this apple pie many times with both cooked and uncooked fillings. While they both have their place, I found that a fresh apple filling made a delicious, classic apple pie without the added steps and time of cooking and cooling the filling before assembly. items.title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes Recipe
items.description: Most buttermilk pancake recipes are more or less the same. But mine is set apart, in a very intentional way: the batter is thicker and rests before cooking. When I was testing this recipe, I tried different amounts of buttermilk, different ways of mixing the batter, and letting the batter sit or not, all to see how the thickness of the batter influenced the resulting pancakes. The thicker batter made the fluffiest pancakes! RECIPE: https://preppykitchen.com/buttermilk-pancakes/ ORDER MY NEW BOOK! items.title: Easy Tart Crust Recipe
items.description: Learn how to make a crisp, tender tart crust in about 10 minutes! The pâte sucrée-style dough can be rolled out to fill a tart pan or pressed straight into the pan for a super easy tart shell. To start, it’s important to note that a tart crust is not simply a sweet pie crust. It is closer to a shortbread cookie in texture: dense, crisp, lightly sweetened, and sturdy enough to hold a wet filling without going soft underneath. This one comes together in about ten minutes in a food processor or by hand. RECIPE: https://preppykitchen.com/tart-crust/ ORDER MY NEW BOOK! items.title: Fluffy Milk Bread Recipe | Shokupan
items.description: Japanese milk bread (also called shokupan and Hokkaido milk bread) is a fluffy, slightly sweet bread popular in parts of Asia. It is known for its signature texture, which is both chewy and incredibly soft. This foolproof Japanese milk bread recipe is a must-try for a loaf that is unbelievably tender, soft, and just a little sweet. Milk bread is honestly so rich and delicious you can slice it up and eat it plain! But I share lots of ideas below for how to serve it. Soft, pillowy Japanese milk bread is a bread lover’s dream. It’s slightly sweet and springy with a nice chew thanks to a special ingredient called tangzhong. Try this delicious bread the next time you want to bake homemade bread. items.title: Easy Lemon Cupcakes Recipe
items.description: Most homemade lemon cupcakes taste like vanilla cupcakes with a whisper of lemon, but not my recipe! The trick is one I use in almost every lemon dessert I make: rub the sugar and fresh zest together first so the sugar’s crystals grind the citrus oils right out of the peel. You end up with damp, sunshine-yellow lemon sugar that smells like a lemon grove, and infuses real lemon flavor into the cake crumb.
